# Third-Party Headers

Place the dependency headers in this directory before building:

- `json.hpp` – [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) single-header release.
- `httplib.h` – [cpp-httplib](https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib) single-header release.

The provided `Makefile` assumes these files exist under `third_party/`.
